label: Duplicate TMA stores
text: Matching same-warp duplicate TMA stores are races in the model, but are reported as warnings under the assumption that their stored values agree.

label: Representative election
text: Election selects lane zero when participating, otherwise the lowest participating lane.

label: Failed launch cancellation
text: Every cluster launch cancellation request fails.

label: Representative branches
text: Choose fallthrough for an unresolved structured if/else; unknown ordinary instruction guards execute. Terminal control uses CFG classification. Known control and explicit choices take precedence.

label: Bounded computation loops
text: Execute a configured number of body iterations for unresolved recognized computation loops, counted separately per invocation. Polling and unclassified loops are never forced to complete.

label: Order-independent atomics
text: The kernel is correct for every order in which concurrent atomics (atom, red) on the same element take effect. Each atomic is one indivisible access; two atomics on the same element whose scopes include both threads do not race.

label: Floating values stay in range
text: In the numerical (equivalence) model a finite value of an IEEE type lies within that type's finite range, so beside a finite operand the type's most negative (largest) finite value never decides a Maximum (Minimum).

label: Compiler constants of transcendentals
text: In the numerical (equivalence) model a recognized compiler expansion of exp, log or log2 that computes with a rounded binary32 constant (log2(e), ln 2) or a minimax polynomial is read as the exact transcendental. This is an approximation, not an equality over the reals; the comparison lists each use (equivalence.idealizations) with the constant it replaced.
